title: Evidence package for shortcut-aware electrocardiogram screening of Chagas disease: locked protocols, hashes, test-set reads and extended results
description: Evidence package accompanying the manuscript Shortcut-aware electrocardiogram screening for Chagas disease with demographic context and missing leads (Y. Zhang, H. Zhao and J. Zhou). It contains the locked protocols and lock files of all test-set reads, the test-set usage log, the complete list of test-set reads with their hypothesis families, the training budgets of all compared methods and the extended results (Appendices A to D). No data are included. The code will be released upon acceptance.
